_doc: Living art: a card's still painting brought to life in the card shader (assets/shaders/living_art.gdshaderinc,
ArtLiving). THE AUTHORING GUIDE, with every key, layer kind and mask shape, is docs/LIVING_ART.md (the mask
vocabulary is also at the top of tools/cards/living_mask.py). A card with living art never plays its Wan loop.
All positions are in the full picture's UV (0..1 across assets/cards/art/<id>.jpg, y down).
Francesca's entry is the original whirl format (legacy mask keys swirl / flame / sway / figures / still / protect,
described below); every other card paints its masks with 'regions' and may add up to three 'layers'.
Motion: vortex [x, y] is the centre of the whirl; swirl is its flow speed (UV per second) and spiral how much of it
turns inward; churn the amplitude (UV) of a crisp wave running along the whirl's arms; period the flow cycle
in seconds (the drift is reset every cycle, cross-faded, so it never tears).
rise: the extra upward flow of the flames; flicker / glow: how much the flames' light trembles and breathes;
haze: heat shimmer (UV); sway: the flutter of hair and cloth (UV); wind [x, y]: the direction they stream;
embers: density 0..1 of the sparks drawn on the whirl (0 = none); ember_color.
The mask (assets/cards/living/<id>.png, written by tools/cards/living_mask.py from 'mask' below): R where the whirl
flows, G the flames, B the hair and cloth that sway. Faces ('protect') are black in every channel, so nothing ever
bends a face; 'still' shapes (the starlings) keep out of the flow so they keep their shape; 'figures' are polygons
the whirl and the flames go around.

ih_antaeus.note: The earth-born: the ground under his palm glows and its fire runs up the veins of his arm, sparks rise off the plain, his chest heaves, his hair and beard stir, the storm clouds roll, a flame licks the rocks.

regions.note: the clouds on the left roll away
the lit ground under the palm

ih_boiling_tide.note: The boiling river: the blood swirls round the drowning arm and ripples, its splashes leap and flicker, bubbles rise and burst, the river's light seethes, a red steam drifts up over the dark cliffs.

regions.note: the splashes and the bubbles leap

ih_cocytus_winter.note: Winter of Cocytus at dusk: the low sun breathes behind the drifting clouds, its light glints warm across the frozen sheet, spindrift blows low over the ice, a camp fire flickers in the chasm and its smoke curls up.

regions.note: the smoke above the fire curls up

ih_ephialtes.note: The chained giant in the well: his eyes burn, his chest heaves with rage, the firelight flickers over his body, the burning water at his knees ripples and its flames lick up, his hair and beard stir, the storm clouds roll, the lava drips at the well's rim.

ih_gate_angel.note: The fallen angel at the gate of Dis: the fire behind the bars rises and flickers, soft motes of light drift up, parallel shafts of firelight slant down from the burning wall, the light trembles on his feathers, the great wings and his hair stir.

regions.note: the fire behind the gate and on the wall

ih_malacoda.note: The chief of the Malebranche: his eyes smoulder, his mane streams and his hooked tail lashes, the storm clouds roll behind his horns, the fires among his demons rise and flicker, and their smoke drifts up.

ih_nimrod.note: Nimrod among the ruins: his long hair and beard stream in the wind, grey ash drifts down, the clouds roll past his horn, the fire behind the broken wall rises and throws a trembling light on the stones, its smoke climbs.

ih_typhon.note: The storm giant: his freezing breath pours from his mouth and billows into the storm, lightning flickers through the clouds, sleet slants down, his eyes blaze, his hair whips, the icy sea heaves and ripples at his feet.

mc_alberigo.note: Fra Alberigo: his frozen tears and the ice in his beard and lashes glint, snow drifts in the dark behind him, his breath smokes in the cold, the wisps of his beard and hair stir.

regions.note: the grey hair over his ear

mc_bocca.note: Bocca in his block of ice: the fire trapped inside the ice flickers and rises, light slides slowly through the veins of the block, frost glints on its edges, a cold vapour spills over its rim and along the frozen ground.

regions.note: not the warm skin of his neck
vapour off the top of the block

mc_frozen_lake.note: The frozen lake: the grey clouds roll, pale shafts of light slant through a gap in them, steam rises off the dark cracks in the ice, the molten veins in them pulse and their flames flicker.

regions.note: steam rises off the dark cracks

mc_guido.note: Guido in his tongue of fire: the flames roar up round him and flicker, sparks fly up and blink out, the heat shimmers, dark smoke rolls in the background, the firelight trembles on his hood and robe.

regions.note: the dark smoke behind rolls up

mc_judas.note: Judas sunk in Cocytus: rings of ripples spread from his body across the black water, frost glints on the broken ice plates, his wet hair stirs, the storm clouds drift, the red light breathes in the clouds and on the horizon.

regions.note: the rings spread out from him

mc_lucifer.note: Cocytus: the icy water ripples and glints, snow drifts down, the fire veins on his chest and his eyes glow, the wings stir, the clouds drift, a flame licks his hip.

regions.note: the clouds between the wings drift
not across the body at the waterline

mc_ruggieri.note: Ruggieri at the tower of hunger: a lamp gutters in the tower window, the sunset smoulders behind the walls and its shafts slant across the tower, the storm clouds drift, his heavy cape and the hem of his robes stir.

regions.note: shafts of the sunset slant across the tower

mc_six_wings.note: The wind of the six wings: the great wings beat slowly and their feathers flutter, the white wind streams out over the ice and its gusts whirl up, the fiery clouds behind the wings roll and smoulder.

mc_ulysses.note: Ulysses at the prow: the beacon flames roar and its lantern blazes, smoke rolls off it across the night sky, the fire on the hull flickers, the dark sea heaves and ripples and foam glints on the crests.

regions.note: the beacon flames and the fire on the hull
the smoke rolls off the beacon
its light on the sails and the tower

phlegyas.note: The Styx: the water runs past the boat and ripples, moonlight glints on it and the moon breathes, fog creeps over the far water, the clouds drift, the trees and his hair stir.

regions.note: the Styx runs right to left past the boat
the clouds, not the dark branches

cd_capaneus.note: Fire rain: burning drops stream down across the sky, the flames rise and flicker, the smoke rolls up, the firelight trembles on his armour, the plume and the cloak stir.

regions.note: the smoke on the left rolls up

minos.note: The judge: his eyes and the serpent's burn and pulse, his chest swells slowly, the fires on both sides rise and flicker, smoke drifts up past the pillars and the clouds roll.

pj_harpy_of_the_wood.note: The wood of the suicides: the bare branches sway, fog drifts between the far trees, the wounds in the trees glow and their blood trickles, the wing feathers stir.

regions.note: the leaves at the bottom right
